3. Fine tuning: Use the software's "Tab 5".

Hello @SaifDemos,

Not sure if you managed to do the calibration but when I saw your issue I did a lot of research before using the software and i figured out a way to do it with minimum burnt DVDs. I was working with Claude on it and I managed to do it with only 3 burnt DVDs with the third one for testing so you can just use the third one right away for what you want and only waste 2. I asked Claude to write me a summary of all the steps and issues I faced so here it is below. I hope it helps!

# Burning a picture on a DVD with DiscImageStudio: calibration guide

This guide is for when DiscImageStudio burns rings, a whirlpool or a swirled picture instead of your image. It's the process that finally worked for me.

## Why calibration is needed

DiscImageStudio draws the picture with the burned data itself. To put every pixel in the right place, it needs your disc's exact spiral: where the data track starts (inner radius) and how far apart the turns are (track pitch). A DVD has about 38,000 turns, so a tiny error adds up to dozens of turns by the edge, and the picture turns into rings. The built-in presets only work if your discs happen to match them.

The plan:

1. Measure your discs with **disc-probe**. It uses your burner to measure the spiral, with no photos needed.
2. Burn one **fine calibration target** in DiscImageStudio to check the measurement.
3. If the target isn't straight, **photograph and trace it** once to correct the rest.
4. Burn your picture.

## Before you start

**Buy a full pack of the same discs, not loose discs.** The spiral differs between manufacturers and even between production batches of the same disc. A preset measured on one batch can be dozens of turns off on another. Measure and burn using discs from the **same pack**. You'll use at least 3 discs (1 to measure, 1 calibration target, 1 for the picture), so get a 10-pack.

**Don't trust the label.** My discs are sold as Sony, and the ring around the hole says "DVD-R", but the drive reads them as DVD+R made by MCC. The `info` command in Step 2 tells you what the disc really is.

**You need:**

- A Windows PC with a DVD burner
- [[DiscImageStudio](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio)](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio)
- [[disc-probe](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe)](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe), plus Python 3.10+ and Git
- [[ImgBurn](https://www.imgburn.com/)](https://www.imgburn.com), a free burner (decline any extra software its installer offers)
- A phone camera and a sharp needle or craft knife (only needed for Step 8)

## Step 1: Install disc-probe

Open PowerShell **as administrator**, because the tool talks to the drive directly:

```
git clone https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe
cd disc-probe
python -m pip install numpy pillow scipy
python -m discprobe selftest
python -m discprobe list
```

`list` shows your drive letter. I use `E:` below. disc-probe only reads from the drive and never writes to it. It's updated often, so run `git pull` before you start.

## Step 2: Check a blank disc

Insert a blank disc from your pack and run:

```
python -m discprobe info --drive E:
```

Note down:

- **`Current profile` and the MID line.** These say what the disc really is (DVD+R or DVD-R, and who made it).
- **The sector count** printed at the end ("Sector count for disexport --sectors"). Mine was `2295104`.

## Step 3: Burn a measuring disc

```
python -m discprobe random --output iso\random.iso
```

Burn `random.iso` on a disc from the pack. Windows' **Burn disc image** works for this one. The burned disc looks empty in File Explorer, which is normal.

If a later step says **"no readable recorded area"**, nothing was written. Eject the disc, reinsert it and run `info` again. If it says `Disc status: empty`, burn it again.

## Step 4: Check that your drive can measure

Leave the burned disc in the drive:

```
python -m discprobe timing --drive E:
```

Check two things:

- **`Rotation: CAV`.** This is required. If it says CLV, try adding `--speed 5540` or `--speed 11080`.
- **Jitter on the `Zone` lines.** About 1° or less is good (mine was 0.5–1.5°). Around 10° or more means the drive is too noisy for this method, so try another drive.

## Step 5: Measure the geometry

```
python -m discprobe geo --drive E:
```

This takes about 3 minutes.

**Problem I hit:** it stopped right away with `could not measure LBA ... near the reference`. My drive (an LG GT30N slim drive) switches to a different rpm whenever it gets *any* speed command, whatever speed you ask for, and at that rpm the first measurement fails. The fix is to let the drive keep its own speed:

```
python -m discprobe geo --drive E: --speed keep
```

If you get the same error, check the rpm on the `Spindle settled` line. If it's the same no matter which speed you request, skip the speeds the tool suggests and use `--speed keep`.

**Reading the result.** Look at the line `angles known to about X deg`:

| X | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0.25° or less | Good |
| 0.25–0.6° | Usable (mine was 0.39°) |
| More than 0.6° | Too noisy, don't use it |

Run it twice. Both runs should show the same `r0` and `pitch`. Pick the run with the lower X, and note its results folder (for example `results\geo-E-20261108-003855`) and its measured span (for example `25.628-54.166 mm`).

## Step 6: Export the preset into DiscImageStudio

Close DiscImageStudio, then run:

```
python -m discprobe disexport --geo results\geo-E-XXXXXXXX-XXXXXX --sectors 2295104 --r-min 25.628 --r-max 54.166 --id my-disc --name "My disc (batch)" --install
```

- **`--geo`:** the folder of your best run. Don't use `latest`, because it picks the newest run, not the best one.
- **`--sectors`:** the number from Step 2.
- **`--r-min` / `--r-max`:** the measured span from Step 5.
- **`--install`:** adds the preset to DiscImageStudio and backs up its preset file first.

## Step 7: Check with a fine calibration target (don't skip this)

**[Should read fine calibration tutorial first for more clarity (click here)](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/blob/main/docs/CALIBRATION_TUTORIAL.md#%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%89%E9%98%B6%E6%AE%B5%E7%B2%BE%E7%BB%86%E6%A0%87%E5%AE%9A%E5%90%8C%E6%97%B6%E6%8B%9F%E5%90%88%E5%8D%8A%E5%BE%84%E5%92%8C%E8%BD%A8%E8%B7%9D%E5%BD%A2%E7%8A%B6)**

disc-probe can be wrong in a way it can't detect. My two measurements agreed perfectly and looked accurate, but my first picture came out **swirled**: faces recognizable, but twisted by about 117° between the center and the edge. Tracing the target in Step 8 showed the cause. My drive reports each read as finished one data block (16 sectors) later than disc-probe expects. That shifts the whole spiral without showing up in the measurement. So check before you burn your picture:

1. **Create the target.** In DiscImageStudio, open **Assisted Calibration**, choose **Fine calibration**, disc type DVD, and your new preset. Check that the sectors and radii match, then click **New target**. It saves an `.iso` and a `.calibration.json` record. Keep both.
2. **Burn it** on a fresh disc from the same pack (see [[Burning](https://claude.ai/chat/91287703-c6b4-4241-b40a-7ae20e9f8f20#burning-targets-and-pictures)](#burning-targets-and-pictures)).
3. **Look at it under a bright light:**
   - **The cross arms are straight:** you're done, so go to Step 9.
   - **The arms are curved:** go to Step 8.

## Step 8: Photograph and trace the target (only if the arms are curved)

You only need to do this once.

**Getting a good photo is the hard part.** The arms can be clear to the eye and still barely show in a photo. What finally worked for me: holding the disc under the light, I **lightly scratched along the center of one arm with a sharp needle**, so the line showed clearly in the photo. Follow the arm carefully, because the correction is only as accurate as your scratch. It's a test disc, so scratching it doesn't matter.

**Photo tips:**

- Lay the disc flat on a plain dark background, with the phone straight above it (use the camera's level indicator).
- Get the **whole disc** in the frame, including the full outer edge and the center hole.
- Don't let a light reflection cover the outer edge or the hole.

**In DiscImageStudio,** open the calibration record for this disc and import the photo:

1. **Correct the perspective.** Choose 12 cm.
   - **Outer points:** on the physical outer edge of the disc, outside the thin clear rim.
   - **Inner points:** on the edge of the center hole.
   - **Avoid:** the edge of the burned area, the clear plastic ring with the molded text, and the raised ridge around the hole. Only the outer edge (120 mm disc) and the hole (15 mm) have fixed sizes, so anything else gives a wrong scale.
2. **Trace the arm.** Click points along the scratched center line from inside to outside, at least 12 (I used 41), covering at least 60% of the burned width. Tick **fit cubic track pitch**. Follow one arm only, never a circle.
3. **Solve.** The error should be well under 0.35 mm (mine was 0.068 mm). Check that the predicted line follows the arm along its whole length.
4. **Save the result.** Tick **"I checked the full curve; its shape and turns match"**, click **Apply calibration**, then **Save as preset**. Apply on its own doesn't change your picture project.
5. **Switch your project to it.** In your picture project, open **Project settings** (click the project name at the top left) and select the new preset.

The new numbers will look almost identical to the old ones. A 117° twist corresponds to a radius change of less than 0.001 mm.

## Step 9: Make and burn the picture

1. **Create a DVD project** with your final preset, or switch to it in Project settings.
2. **Import your picture:**
   - Pick a picture with strong contrast and a clear subject. Crop it tight and simplify the background.
   - **Dithering:** lower (20–30%) makes it bolder and easier to see, and higher keeps more detail but looks fainter. Compare on the Preview page.
   - **Adding a video or files:** they take up a ring of the disc that can't hold picture. Put them on the **outer ring**, where the calibration is least accurate anyway, and keep them small. The Preview page shows the file area in blue.
3. **Export the ISO.** Open the `.iso.json` next to it and check that `totalSectors`, `innerRadiusMm` and `outerRadiusMm` under `imageMapping` match your preset. If they don't, the wrong preset is selected.
4. **Burn it** on a fresh disc from the same pack.

## Burning (targets and pictures)

- **Use ImgBurn → Write image file to disc.** Windows' built-in burner says *"The selected disc image file isn't valid"* for picture-only images. That's because they contain no file system, not because they're broken.
- **Write speed:** use the lowest speed your drive supports for the disc. `info` lists the speeds (mine were 2.4x, 4x and 8x, so I used 2.4x). Use the same speed every time, and avoid AWS and MAX.
- **Untick Verify.** Picture areas often don't read back cleanly, so Verify can report errors even when the burn is fine.
- **Don't use DiscImageStudio's live burning.** It's experimental, so export the ISO instead.
- **A picture-only disc looks empty or unreadable in Windows.** That's normal. Don't let any program "repair" or format it.

## Viewing the disc

Hold one small, bright light, such as a phone flashlight, right next to your eye or camera, and tilt the disc until you see its reflection. The picture appears around the reflection. The rainbow "pizza slices" are normal. In ordinary room light the picture can be almost invisible.

## Troubleshooting

| What you see | Likely cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Rings or a whirlpool, no picture | Wrong preset, or a disc from a different batch | Check the `.iso.json` values, and use discs from the pack you measured |
| Recognizable but swirled picture | Drive timing offset (see Step 7) | Trace the fine calibration target (Step 8) |
| `no readable recorded area` | The measuring disc is blank or the burn failed | Run `info`, then burn it again |
| `geo` stops "near the reference" | The drive changes rpm when given a speed | Use `--speed keep` |
| Windows: "image file isn't valid" | Picture-only ISOs have no file system | Burn with ImgBurn |
| Faint picture | Lighting or tone settings | Use one bright point light, lower dithering, add contrast |

## My setup, for reference

- **Drive:** HL-DT-ST (LG) DVDRAM GT30N slim drive
- **Discs:** Sony-branded DVD+R, MID `MCC/003/0` (the hub says "DVD-R"), 2,295,104 sectors
- **disc-probe:** CAV at about 3,500 rpm with `--speed keep`; r0 23.948 mm, pitch 0.7371 µm, accuracy 0.39°
- **Fine calibration:** 41 points, 0.068 mm error
- **Burning:** ImgBurn at 2.4x

## Links

- DiscImageStudio: https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio
- disc-probe: https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe
- How disc-probe works: DiscImageStudio issue #72
- Drive reports: DiscImageStudio Discussion #107

title: 刻盘之后无法正常重新读取
body:
我发现，我的Ritek ARITA DVD-R（MID `RITEKF1` 内环标签`dr5f60-pw104`），在刻录了DiscImageStudio产生的标靶镜像文件后，发现会100%使得光盘无法正常读取。

无论刻录使用`cdrecord`还是`cdrskin`，速度使用max还是4，刻录完成后，弹出再插入，使用`pv /dev/sr0 > /dev/null`读取，都能在dmesg中发现开头的一些扇区出现损坏。大概是这样的消息：

```log
[607146.887024] sr 1:0:0:0: [sr1] tag#0 FAILED Result: hostbyte=DID_OK driverbyte=DRIVER_OK cmd_age=4s
[607146.887033] sr 1:0:0:0: [sr1] tag#0 Sense Key : Medium Error [current]
[607146.887034] sr 1:0:0:0: [sr1] tag#0 Add. Sense: L-EC uncorrectable error
[607146.887036] sr 1:0:0:0: [sr1] tag#0 CDB: Read(10) 28 00 00 00 02 00 00 02 00 00
[607146.887037] critical medium error, dev sr1, sector 2048 op 0x0:(READ) flags 0x80700 phys_seg 256 prio class 2
```

如果不用这个标靶文件，用我自己制作的一张图画iso，写入后会发现总是在大概220MiB处会出现medium error io error。

我已用了两台刻录机`ASUS BW-16D1H-U`和`ASUS SDRW-08U9M-U`做了交叉验证，好像真的是这样。就非常神奇。按我所理解，光盘用户可编程区域即iso内容无论是什么数据都不会影响到光盘物理读取的。不知道有没有人遇到此情况。

nodes.body: 同样是这张盘（在一个盒子中），如果产生同样光盘满扇区大小的随机文件来刻录，以及包括我在此之前刻录过的所有这个ritek盘，都是正常读取。看起来好像真的是特定的此项目产生iso的影响。但真的无法理解。
似乎纯黑/纯白就会有问题，我刻录的灰度图片有一次就全盘校验成功了
主要真的是太神奇了。我不知道这种情况是不是真的可能发生的。还是我的盘/刻录机有问题。用户区的数据怎么会影响读取的……

甚至，好像还会发生在DVD+RW上。我刻上一张这个项目的iso，然后之后读取时就很费力，和DVD-R差不多的效果，光驱一直卡住好久忙灯一直在闪，电脑日志出现很多medium error。但如果顶着这些错误硬是给它从头填零，比如使用dd往/dev/sr0写入200M的零字节，盘片退出再插入，就不会有错误了，且`pv /dev/sr0 > /dev/null`也正常读取，但当遇到200MB时也就是遇到了这个项目的艺术iso图案时，又开始卡住然后medium error了。真的非常神奇！！

我记得许久使用DVD-RAM时，发现一种情况。那时我给盘写入纯声音PCM数据，写完后那张盘就马上就废了，读取会很卡很卡很多medium error。但再开一张全新的DVD-RAM然后写些其他数据正常数据哪怕随机数据，就没问题，但只要是再写我那点音乐PCM数据，写完后退出再插入，就读取出问题。似乎这种情况真的是可发生的。……

**中文**

目前的排查结果还只是初步判断，尚未使用报告中的 ISO 和介质完成实盘复现，不能确定根因。

从现有反馈看，比较值得怀疑的是：**大片纯色对应的重复数据纹理，可能影响某些介质与驱动器组合的读取可靠性。** 同批介质写入随机数据可以正常读取，而绘图数据出现 `L-EC uncorrectable error`；灰度图片可以成功读取、DVD+RW 覆写为零后对应区域恢复可读的反馈，也支持继续沿这个方向排查。[[#72](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/72)](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/72) 中也有纯单字节纹理引发重试和变速的类似观察。

代码检查发现，DVD 绘图会预先抵消驱动器的扰码，使大片纯色在正常扰码后仍对应重复的 `0xA5` / `0x92` 数据。使用当前编码器进行的软件模拟显示，这些纹理的局部 DSV（数字和变化，用于观察信号低频偏置）明显高于随机数据，尤其是白色对应的 `0x92`。不过，这只是软件模型中的结果，**不能直接证明实际刻录器生成了相同信号，也不能据此断定具体故障机制**。

目前也没有证据表明这是缺少 ECC 导致的：快速模式省略的是软件侧模拟，实际刻录时仍由驱动器生成 ECC。默认抖动不会打散大片纯黑、纯白；简单混入少量其他数据，在模拟中也不一定能改善所有指标，因此暂时还不能把它当作已验证的修复。

下一步建议：

- 收集出问题的 ISO、软件版本、生成及刻录参数，并记录读取失败的 LBA 范围。
- 用不同驱动器读取同一张问题光盘，区分写入结果和读取端的影响。
- 在相同位置、相同数据长度下，对比随机数据、两种纯色纹理及混合纹理，再决定是否需要调整纹理或增加兼容性选项。

介质质量、刻录策略及驱动器兼容性仍需一并排查。现阶段应把上述解释视为待验证的假设。

---

**English**

These findings are preliminary. We have not yet reproduced the failure on physical media using the reported ISO, so the root cause remains unconfirmed.

One plausible explanation is that **the repetitive data patterns used for large solid-color areas may reduce read reliability with certain media/drive combinations.** Reports that random data reads successfully on media from the same batch, while artwork data produces `L-EC uncorrectable error`, make this worth investigating. The successful grayscale-image test and the DVD+RW observation that overwriting an affected region with zeros restores readability also support this direction. [[#72](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/72)](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/72) contains a similar observation of retries and speed changes around a repeated single-byte texture.

Code inspection shows that DVD artwork generation compensates for the drive’s scrambling in advance, leaving repeated `0xA5` / `0x92` data after normal scrambling in solid-color regions. Software simulations using the current encoder show substantially larger local DSV (Digital Sum Variation, an indicator of low-frequency signal imbalance) than random data, particularly for the white `0x92` texture. However, **this does not establish that the actual burner produces the same signal or confirm the physical failure mechanism**.

There is currently no evidence that missing ECC is the cause: fast mode skips software-side simulation, while the drive still generates ECC during recording. Default dithering does not break up solid black or white regions. Adding a small amount of another texture also did not consistently improve every simulated metric, so this is not yet a validated fix.

Suggested next steps:

- Obtain the failing ISO, software version, generation and burning parameters, and the failing LBA ranges.
- Read the same problematic disc in different drives to help separate recording and reading effects.
- Compare random data, both solid-color textures, and mixed textures at the same location and length before considering texture changes or a compatibility option.

Media quality, recording strategy, and drive compatibility still need investigation alongside this hypothesis.

另外，~我将这个转到discussion中去了。因为不算是项目的bug。~ 啊这我好像不能转。

问了下AI，它给出了如下解答：

```text
● 完全破案了。我把 ~/block 用 DVD 扰码器解码后，结论非常干净。

  你的 block 到底是什么

  DVD 主数据在进激光前会被驱动器做一次扰码（15 位 LFSR，多项式
  X¹⁵+X¹¹+1，每扇区把 LFSR 低 8 位逐个 XOR 到 2048 字节上）。

  我把这个扰码器反向套到 ~/block 上，解码出来的盘上数据只有两个字节值：

  sector 0:  0x92(白) ×1343  + 0xA5(黑) ×705
  sector 2:  0x92(白) ×1511  + 0xA5(黑) ×537
  sector 5:  0x92 ×1338  + 0xA5 ×710
  sector 7:  0x92 ×1514  + 0xA5 ×534
  ...

  也就是说 ~/block 是被预先反扰码的数据：它在盘上真实刻出来的就是重复的 0x92 /
  0xA5（白色=0x92，黑色=0xA5），而不是随机数据。

  这正是 DiscImageStudio 为了"在盘上画图"必须做的事——它要控制盘面的物理图案，所
  以会先抵消驱动器的扰码，让大片纯色在扰码之后仍对应重复的 0xA5/0x92。这也是
  issue #90 里 maintainer 已经写到的结论，我这边用你的 block 文件把它坐实了。

  为什么重复 0x92/0xA5 会导致 3/11/05

  EFM+ 把每个字节映射成 16 位码字。重复同一个字节 = 重复同一组码字，信道信号的
  DSV（digital sum value，直流偏置）就会累积，超出读通道 slicer/伺服的容忍范围 →
  PI/PO 纠错失败 → L-EC UNCORRECTABLE。

  这就是 DVD 防拷贝里著名的"弱扇区（weak sector）"手法——EP2031592A1 (http://pate
  ntimages.storage.googleapis.com/c0/0d/ae/2cb37f0787e74e/EP2031592A1.pdf)
  就是靠写重复字节（比如 0x8e）制造不可读扇区。你的艺术图里，白色 0x92 和黑色
  0xA5 就是同一个性质的"杀手纹理"。

  为什么跟 LBA 位置有关（你 block 测试里的 100/500 正常、2000/4000/8000 失败）

  扰码器的初值取自扇区 ID 的 bit7–4，而 bit7–4 = ECC block 编号 mod 16。你的
  block 是从 block 4000 提取的：

  ┌────────────┬────────┬──────────┬───────────┬─────────┐
  │ 写到 block │ mod 16 │ 扰码初值 │ 盘上图案  │  结果   │
  ├────────────┼────────┼──────────┼───────────┼─────────┤
  │ 2000       │ 0      │ 匹配     │ 0x92/0xA5 │ ❌ 失败 │
  ├────────────┼────────┼──────────┼───────────┼─────────┤
  │ 4000       │ 0      │ 匹配     │ 0x92/0xA5 │ ❌ 失败 │
  ├────────────┼────────┼──────────┼───────────┼─────────┤
  │ 8000       │ 0      │ 匹配     │ 0x92/0xA5 │ ❌ 失败 │
  ├────────────┼────────┼──────────┼───────────┼─────────┤
  │ 100        │ 4      │ 不匹配   │ 别的图案  │ ✅ 正常 │
  ├────────────┼────────┼──────────┼───────────┼─────────┤
  │ 500        │ 4      │ 不匹配   │ 别的图案  │ ✅ 正常 │
  └────────────┴────────┴──────────┴───────────┴─────────┘

  只有扰码初值匹配（mod 16 = 0）的位置，这块数据才会被还原成 0x92/0xA5
  杀手图案。完美对上你的实验。

  你最初的直觉 vs 真相

  你最初的判断"用户数据不能影响物理"对正常数据是成立的：正常数据（随机、甚至全零
  ）被扰码器 XOR 成伪随机，EFM+ 保证 DSV 有界，内容确实无关。

  但这个工具故意反扰码，把物理图案精确控制成重复字节——这是唯一能让"内容"真正影响
  刻录的方式。所以：

  - 随机文件正常（扰码后随机，DSV 有界）✅
  - 纯黑/纯白失败（0x92/0xA5 重复，DSV 杀手）❌
  - 灰度图那次成功（抖动打散了重复）✅
  - DVD+RW 覆写零恢复（零→扰码→伪随机，DSV 正常；且重写重造相变坑）✅
  - 全 ISO 在 LBA 63184–113423 失败（那正是艺术图里的大片纯色区）❌

  结论

  不是你的盘、不是你的刻录机、也不是"灵异"。 是 DiscImageStudio
  生成的纯色纹理在盘上形成重复字节图案，触发了和防拷贝弱扇区相同的 DSV
```

我又看了些，按AI的说法大概是这样的：DVD的刻录过程是，用户数据P->扰码Q->EFM+码字->坑岸。使用P->Q的逆算法使得Q总是为某个字节（杀手字节，比如0xed），从而最终会产生特定的高直流偏置坑岸（比如码字是0b0000000001000001，坑岸就是9岸6坑1岸，DSV值（加和的直流偏置）就是9-6+1=4，这样一直累加就会产生一个很大的DSV值。然后带偏了电压判决器影响了坑岸的判定，从而读了错误的数据，当然就无法通过ecc校验，于是直接报出`L-EC uncorrectable error`的scsi sense。

这里有一份AI写的 https://gist.github.com/bczhc/7f41fd988f8944619feea4bb81db7fa0 弱扇区生成，就是利用这个原理，给一个iso路径，给一个起始和结束位置，就能原地修改镜像那部分的数据，填充精心设计的P值让P在变成扰码Q后就等于杀手字节（`--killer`参数）。

```bash
dd if=/dev/zero of=img bs=1M count=1024
python weak.py img $((500*32)) $((800*32)) --killer 0xed
cdrskin -v -data img
```

一个示例见上。这样做了之后，刻出的DVD盘，其500MiB到800MiB的位置，就是完全不可读的。读取会直接报Medium error (L-EC uncorrectable error)。

@bczhc 再更新一次，这次有实质内容。我们请 AI 核对了模型，结果我们用自己的代码复算过。

**更正：** 我们的编码器有个 bug，状态 3/4 的 secondary SY6 写错了（`0x90440011` 应为 `0x80440011`，已修，[add4f87](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/commit/add4f87)）。所以上面说的 `8E` 约 715、排第一都不对，修正后约 373，比 `ED` 的 377 还低一点。你这块的结果没变，仍然是失败位置 307 到 311，能读的位置 20 到 25。

**`92` 为什么会这样：** 它的码字有两种。状态 1、3 下是 8T/8T，没有直流偏置。状态 2、4 下是 6T/10T，每个字节偏 4，下一状态又是 2，于是出不来，一帧 79 个字节就累积到约 316。所以纯 `92` 不一定有问题，要看入口的状态。到下一个同步码时，状态会重置。

**`A5` 的高峰来自 PO：** 全 `A5` 的数据行只有 17，高峰在 PO 行。用户区每列都一样时，校验字节也一样，某个 PO 行里会有 156 个重复的 `EE`，峰值 325。所以光处理 `92` 不够。

**可能的解决办法（只在模型里验证过）：** 把你这块每段 `92` 的第一个字节换掉，共改 168 字节（约 0.5%），峰值从 311 降到 22 到 26，和能读的位置差不多。换成 `75` 或 `9B` 最稳：我们枚举了所有状态，它们之后的 `92` 只能走没有偏置的循环，而 `66`、`A5` 之后还可能进入有偏置的循环。全 `A5` 改 78 个字节打散 PO，也能从 325 降到 23，但这不是通用办法，有的扰动反而更糟，每个 ECC 块都要算一遍。

**我们测不了这一点：** 模型只说明偏置没了，不能证明盘就读得出来。我们的 GH70N 读这类盘本来就几乎不报错，看不出区别。你的两台 ASUS 是稳定失败的，又可以用 DVD+RW 写同样的位置，所以如果你有兴趣，这是最直接的验证。下面这段脚本把你的 `block` 改成桥接版，存成 `block_bridged`，再像之前那样写到 2000、4000、8000 块回读就行：

```python
import numpy as np

raw = np.fromfile("block", np.uint8)
assert raw.size == 32768
lba = 64000  # 这块原来的位置，要和生成时一致，也就是块 4000
PRESETS = (0x0001, 0x5500, 0x0002, 0x2A00, 0x0004, 0x5400, 0x0008, 0x2800,
           0x0010, 0x5000, 0x0020, 0x2001, 0x0040, 0x4002, 0x0080, 0x0005)


def mask(preset):
    reg, out = preset, np.empty(2048, np.uint8)
    for i in range(2048):
        out[i] = reg & 0xFF
        for _ in range(8):
            reg = ((reg << 1) | (((reg >> 14) ^ (reg >> 10)) & 1)) & 0x7FFF
    return out


m = mask(PRESETS[((lba + 0x30000) >> 4) & 0xF])
out = raw.copy()
for s in range(16):
    rec = raw[s * 2048:(s + 1) * 2048] ^ m
    first = (rec == 0x92) & (np.r_[0, rec[:-1]] != 0x92)
    rec[first] = 0x9B
    out[s * 2048:(s + 1) * 2048] = rec ^ m
out.tofile("block_bridged")
print((out != raw).sum(), "bytes changed")
```

应该显示改了 168 个字节。写到块 100 这种不匹配的位置没有意义，那里本来就能读。如果还是读不出，就说明 DSV 不是全部原因，这个结果同样有用。

另外，改了之后图案会不会变，我们也还不知道。`92` 从 6T/10T 变成 8T/8T，理想计算里周期不变，一级衍射反而强约 17%，但这还要刻盘看。

```
  LBA  1389936:  265 ->   50
  LBA  1516448:  309 ->   51
  LBA  1581024:   31 ->   28
  LBA  1668352:  213 ->   46
  LBA  1674896:  145 ->   27
  LBA  2226480:   75 ->   45
worst after: 51
```

@bczhc 太好了，谢谢！旧脚本那次第一个错误在约 2.14 GiB，这次 `pv` 把 4.38 GiB 读完了，图案看起来也没变。

确认两点：`image-bridged2.iso` 是用 [ef38742](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/commit/ef38742) 这版生成的吗？还是原来那台光驱和同一款盘吗？

有空的话可以再比对一次内容，确认读出来的字节和 ISO 一样：

```bash
cmp -n 4700372992 /dev/sr0 /tmp/image-bridged2.iso
```

没有输出就是一致。方便的话，也请发一张原盘和这张盘同角度的对比照。目前这是一台光驱上的一次结果，我想先把它写进主帖。

光盘光驱都没变。Verbatim DVD+RW跟华硕那个BW-16D1H-U。输出不试了，肯定得一致，既然没读错的话。我大抵能信任我的盘和光驱、、

是最新的disc-probe里那个脚本生成的。

拍照的话也不出什么效果，不如我肉眼去对比。看着是没啥差别。
大概，所以这个问题就是解决了？是跟最终码字的DSV有关吗。
如果非要检查dsv处理与不处理的镜像在盘上的表现，得要非常严格控制光照和观察角度完全一样吧。否则其实都大差不差，毕竟软件只用弄出哪儿坑多哪儿岸多来做出对比就行了，实际看的话真没啥差别。

@bczhc 谢谢。没读错的话确实不用再比对，ECC 校验过了。

在你这台光驱和这张盘上，我觉得可以算解决了。范围还不够大，别的光驱和盘还要再试。

原因很可能和最终码字的 DSV 有关，但光驱内部到底怎么出错的，我们没有直接测过。目前的证据是：

- `92` 有两种码字写法，一种平衡，一种每帧都偏向一边。连续的 `92` 落到不平衡那种，DSV 就一直偏着。`9B` 的作用是让后面的 `92` 走平衡的那种。
- 你这边第一个读取错误从约 390 MiB 推到约 2.14 GiB，换新规则后整盘读完，只改了 1.91% 的字节。
- 我们刻了一张对比盘，在 GH70N 上每种内容读 9 块。把 `92` 强制推到不平衡写法后，9 块全读不出；普通 `92` 读出 8 块；其他内容全部读出。

不过 DSV 峰值高不一定读不出：`A5` 模型峰值 325，却都读出了，因为它的峰值只在校验行。所以偏多久可能比偏多高更重要，这一点还没定下来。

我们今天也按同样的方法刻了一张，GH70N 抽查 301 块全部读出。把它和原盘放在一起扫了 3 次，图案没有明显变化：在扫描仪能看到图案的暗区里，图案和背景的亮度差两张都约 21%，测量误差约 ±2 到 3 个百分点，所以更小的差别分辨不出来。这只是一对盘和一台扫描仪。详情我会更新到 [#150](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/150)。

补充一下我上一条的说法：“图案没有明显变化”只适用于扫描仪暗区的中央。按角度分开后，离暗区中心 10° 到 14° 的地方，桥接版 3 次扫描都偏低（平均约 0.06 对 0.08，指标是图案和背景的对数亮度差）。这可能是真的，但信号很弱，还定不下来。数字和图在 [#150](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/150)。

我刚测试了一下杀手字节。遍历0-255，每个字节重复32768次成一个ecc块，把它们都拼起来，拼成32768*256=8MiB的一个镜像。把这个镜像过DVD扰码器得到byte-test.img，烧录此镜像。byte-test.img按理来说在烧写时会再过一遍扰码器，这样EFM+拿到的Q值就是我那些填满了单个字节的数据。

之后使用scsi读取第0, 1, 2, ... 255块，读不出的块位置，就是读不出的Q字节。

用威宝的DVD-RW与+RW两张盘，数据都是那8MiB镜像。用两个光驱ASUS BW-16D1H-U跟ASUS SDRW-08U9M-U来读，交叉来测试。在我这边的测试数据是：

[byte-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34481709/byte-test.zip)

照着efm+表去对每个Q字节模拟。比如0xed，有`ED  0041/1  4842/1  8921/1  4842/1`这一行，state默认取1，则查表得到0x0041/1，斜杠后边代表下一state。下一state还是1，是个自环。展开成16bit去数dsv，得到+4，这样一个ecc block中dsv就会累加起很大。

但有意思的是，0xec的efm+表有`EC  0082/1  4892/1  9021/1  4892/1`，其也是state=1自环，得到DSV=4。但根据我的测试，0xec却不是杀手字节。原因是ECMA-267标准里22节 “Suppress control of the d.c. component”其c项说，

> For the 8-bit bytes in the range 88 to 255, when the prescribed State is 1 or 4, then the 16-bit Code Word can be chosen either from State 1 or from State 4, so as to ensure that the RLL requirement is met.

这样对于0xec，从state1马上能切到state4然后一直state4。但对于0xed，从1切不到4，因为1到4衔接不能满足RLL(2,10)

这是我目前的理解

“长游程”原因更跟硬件设计有关，有些机器设计得能更好读出此类也可理解。btw你的0xa5说是高DSV，但我这边算的它DSV=0。

我这边所产生的数据 [dsv-and-efmplus-table.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34484397/dsv-and-efmplus-table.zip)

@bczhc 这个测试很漂亮！我用 disc-probe 的编码器按完整录制帧（含 ID、PO、PI）算了你这 256 块，你的两条机制和模型对得上，还多了一个可以验证的预测。

| Q | 峰值 DSV | 偏置窗口占比 | ≥8T 的长度占比 | 你的结果 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `ED` | 377 | 77% | 54% | 读不出 |
| `FC` | 377 | 80% | 3% | 读不出 |
| `EC` | 145 | 0.01% | 18% | 能读 |
| `92` | 307 | 0.8% | 87% | 读不出 |
| `A5` | 315 | 0.7% | 4% | 能读 |

偏置窗口占比是 512T 窗口里平均电平偏离超过 0.125 的比例，这是我们之前分 `92`、`92D` 时用的指标。

`ED` 和 `EC` 这组支持你的状态切换解释。`FC` 和 `92` 正好是干净的一对：`FC` 几乎没有长游程，只有直流偏置；`92` 的偏置和能读的 `A5` 差不多，却几乎全是长游程。不过 AI 总结里“一条 8T”这个说法我觉得不太准，正常数据里也有 8T，同步码还有 14T，这里特别的是整块连续都是。

补充一点：`92` 不是总平衡。状态 1、3 是 `0808`（8T/8T，DSV 0），状态 2、4 是 `4010`（6T/10T，每字 ±4），进入状态 2 后会一直留在 2，直到下一个同步码。模型里你这块大部分是 8T/8T，所以偏置不高。我们之前强制走 6T/10T 的 `92D` 在 GH70N 上 9 块全读不出，而普通 `92` 能读 8 块，所以 `92` 两种机制都可能碰到。

和长游程这条对不太上的是你之前的桥接结果：每段 `92` 换掉第一个字节后，8T 基本还在，块却能读了。那些是一半图案、一半别的数据的块，和这里的整块纯 `92` 不一样，可能只有连续够长才出问题。这点我也不确定。

预测（我还没打开你的 zip，所以是先算后对）。如果这两条机制是对的：

- 直流这组（占比 ≥20%）应该读不出：`8E 95 9E E7 ED EE F0 F2 F4 F6 F8 FA FC`
- 长游程这组（偏置低，≥8T 占 87% 以上）也应该读不出：`5F 60 83 87 8D 92`，下一名 `15` 只有 70%，中间有个明显的断层。

方便的话，可以告诉我你那边读不出的字节有哪些，我来对一下，或者你直接对也行。对不上的字节会最有意思。

这只是模型：ID 里的扇区信息字节是假设的，占比的阈值也不是读取界限，只拿来分组。另外你用的是 RW 盘，RITEKF1 上结果可能不同。

@bczhc 你算得对，`A5` 的数据区 DSV 基本是 0，这两条是我们刚好同时发的。我表里 315 这个峰值来自 PO 行，不是 `A5` 本身：用户区全同时每列校验也相同，PO 行里会出现 156 个重复字节（全 `A5` 时 PO 15 是 `EE`），峰值就是这几行冲上去的。所以 `A5` 的偏置窗口占比只有 0.7%，也解释了它峰值高却能读。这也是我们不再只看峰值的原因。

硬件差异这点我同意。我们的 GH70N 读普通 `92` 9 块能读 8 块，你的两台都读不出，所以长游程这条很可能和读取电路有关，读不出的列表也可能因机器而异。

@bczhc @Ashley-QwQ 首先很感谢你们的排查与分析，我也检查了CD和BD的编码流程，结论是CD和BD基本不会出现DSV偏置过大的情况，所以目前只需要集中解决DVD的问题。
按照你们的讨论，问题主要出现在DSV偏置峰值过大以及长游程比例过高上面，目前已提交到主分支的`0x9B`替换方案还不能解决长游程比例过高的问题，GPT给出的一个简单方案是每16/8字节把一个`0x92`替换为`0x9B`，可以烦请你们帮忙测试一下是否有效吗
我之前试了 Ashley-QwQ 他那个bridge脚本，是可以解决的，那个脚本我大概的理解就是，在Q域，0x92前如果有其他数据（比如目前DIS图片透明区域，是随机填充的），EFM+表next state刚好让后面的0x92进到了它自己的非零DSV自环，在它前面加个0x9b诱导一下进入0x92的DSV=0 state自环。并且我现在本地也有个用Rust重写的这个处理
EFM+表 9x92四状态：0808/3  4010/2  0808/3  4010/2。state 1跟3是稳定零dsv自环。但state 2是一个非零dsv自环。除了那些随机数据，dvd自己补的校验头似乎也会影响。所以每一扇区前加个0x9b也是明智操作

> GPT给出的一个简单方案是每16/8字节把一个0x92替换为0x9B

这样解决感觉确实是真简单有效啊。直接固定替换。我还没试但按理解，感觉是能解决的。不知道会不会影响图案观感。

除了92，还有连续的a5，按AI所说在PO校验行里会出现连续杀手字节导致dsv依然高。不过我这边好像还没遇到过由a5引起的读取错误。应该问题轻微一些

@JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat 谢谢！“每 16/8 字节换一个 `9B`”我先用完整录制帧（含 ID、PO、PI）算了模型，还不是读取实测：

| 整块 `92` 的换法 | 峰值 DSV | 偏置窗口占比 F512 | ≥8T 的长度占比 | 最长连续 8T |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 不换 | 315 | 2.61% | 87.0% | 1448T |
| 每 256 字节 | 147 | 0.03% | 87.3% | 1448T |
| 每 64 字节 | 51 | 0% | 85.6% | 1008T |
| **每 16 字节** | 51 | 0% | 79.8% | 248T |
| 每 8 字节 | 130 | 0% | 71.6% | 104T |
| 每 4 字节 | 101 | 0.02% | 56.4% | 48T |

前面先放 64 字节随机数据再接 `92`（更像图片透明区的情况）时趋势相同，每 16 字节峰值 47，每 8 字节 107。

我的看法：

- 直流这边，每 64 字节就基本够了。8 字节的峰值反而比 16 字节高，所以不是换得越密越好。
- 长游程的占比下降很慢，每 16 字节还有约 80%，但最长的连续 8T 从 1448T 缩短到 248T。如果 bczhc 那两台光驱是卡在“连续太久”，16 字节可能就够；如果卡在总占比，就要更密。这两种情况模型分不开，要靠实测。所以我建议先测 16，不行再试 8 或 4。
- 对画面的影响要一起看。每 16 字节换一次时，模型里 16T 那条谱线的功率从 0.55 掉到 0.006，能量分散到相邻的频率上。扫描里 `92` 的亮度有没有变，我们不知道，之前只改约 0.2–2% 字节的桥接版看不出明显差别，换得更密就不一定了。

实测这边我们帮不上太多：我们的 GH70N 读 `92` 本来就很少报错（9 块能读 8 块），比不出差别。bczhc 的两台光驱读连续 `92` 稳定出错，最适合验证。@bczhc 如果方便，可以在你的 byte-test 里加每 64、16、8、4 字节换一次的几块，看从哪一档开始读得出来，这样两种机制也能分开。

我试了两种。（这么看确实都比那个最开始的bridge，简单和直接得多）
一是，每16字节（只要不是a5），就直接置9b。

二是，找连续的92，连续92数量大于一个值（比如16）就给首0x92替换为0x9b。然后，把每扇区首只要不是a5，就直接置9b。

两种都通过了验证。如果不处理，最开始就要报medium error。无论哪种方式处理后，全盘都能正常读出。

- https://github.com/bczhc/dvd-tools/blob/master/src/bin/dvd-guard-runs.rs
- https://github.com/bczhc/dvd-tools/blob/master/src/bin/dvd-guard-every16.rs

@bczhc 太好了，谢谢！两种都读得出，那“每 16 字节”这条路在你的光驱上是通的，和模型里最长连续 8T 从 1448T 缩到 248T 的方向一致。这也说明卡住的可能更多是“连续太久”，不是总占比，不过这还只是一个结果。

现在两种方法的差别就看画面了。第一种改的字节多得多，约 6%；第二种只改每段开头和扇区开头。如果图案对比度看不出差别，第一种更简单；如果第一种明显变淡，第二种更值得。方便的话，同一张图各刻一张比一下，这样 @JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat 选方案时就有依据了。
两者如果观感的话肯定反正至少我看不出什么区别。我自己目前本地的话会使用方案二（连续92前只放一个9b），也可以继续测试我这个方法是否持续有效。因为我希望改动尽量少一些。按道理上应当是没问题的，让它到dsv=0的自环就行了。

title: 求助 标定始终无法成功有没有可能是光驱或者碟片问题
body: 已经按照教程用粗标定和细标定反复测试20多张盘了，粗标定按教程的步骤来看只有数据偏移，利用反向拟合来改，之后把改好的数据刻标定盘，每次最终应该是直线的标定数据刻录出来都会有非常奇怪的问题，拿我最后尝试的一次举例 这一张是基于粗略得出的数据刻录出的标定盘，之后拿软件进行标定 标定的曲线和盘上实际的曲线是相同的，但是把这个标定数据刻录出来却得到无法理解的曲线 曲线非常不自然的折了很多次，我在预览页反向拟合测试数据应该是无法做到这种曲线的，把同一份标定数据重新刻录一张又得到不一样的结果 图案变回第一张标定图那样从内向外的螺旋，螺旋更稀了，但是在开始处依然有折角 之前的标定刻录结果也是这样，下图是其中一张 下面是再之前的标定盘，只有一个折角，但是折角太尖软件标定直接无法识别 这是使用的光盘封面 使用的光驱是笔记本式的便携光驱 25片装的已经全刻废了还是无法标定成功，实在是没办法了

title: 征求意见：#62 DVD 照片自动标定的方向 | Feedback wanted on #62: photo-based DVD auto-calibration
body:
想就 #62（照片自动标定）听听维护者和大家的意见，先确认方向，再继续投入。English below.

## 这个 PR 做什么

新增 `tools/disc-calib`（Python，依赖 OpenCV 和 SciPy）和 `dvd-calib-pattern`、`dvd-calib-solve` 两个 CLI 命令。标定盘的图案自带编码，拍照后直接解出 DVD 的实际内外半径，不需要描线。目前只支持 DVD，只有命令行，没有接入 GUI。

提交 PR 之后，1.4.0 加入了粗标定、边界标定、精细标定的分阶段流程，所以两者的关系需要重新明确。

## 目前的实测结果

样本很小：两张刻录盘，共 12 张手机照片，其中 5 张可读。

- 用第 2 张盘的解算结果生成第 3 张盘，误差从未校准时的 123 圈降到约 0.05 圈。
- 仍有 10° 到 20° 的残余扭曲，切向偏移最大约 8 到 13 mm。没有独立测量真实半径，无法判断这部分来自测量误差，还是盘片或刻录之间的差异。
- 没有拟合三次轨距。

完整数据见 [PR 里的评论](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/pull/62#issuecomment-6627034720)。我也在 #122 征集更多光驱和盘片的照片。

## 想请教的问题

1. **定位：** 这个方法更适合替代粗标定，为边界标定或精细标定提供初值，还是作为独立流程？维护者在 #72 提到现阶段优先改进拍照标定，这个 PR 算不算在这个方向上？
2. **放在哪里：** Python 工具放进仓库并由 CLI 转发可以接受吗？它不打包进单文件 CLI，需要单独安装。还是更希望作为外部工具，仓库里只写文档？
3. **结果怎么用：** 现在输出的是 `code.fit.json`。需要转成 GUI 可以导入的标定记录吗？
4. **精度要求：** 残余扭曲要降到多少才值得合并？合并前是否必须支持三次轨距？
5. **PR 大小：** 现在是 22 个文件、约 3600 行。要不要拆成工具和 CLI 两个 PR？

PR 已 rebase 到 1.4.0，目前没有冲突。`build` 工作流正在等待批准运行，也欢迎先看设计。

---

I'd like feedback from the maintainers and anyone interested on #62 (photo-based auto-calibration), to confirm the direction before investing more in it.

## What the PR does

It adds `tools/disc-calib` (Python, using OpenCV and SciPy) and two CLI commands, `dvd-calib-pattern` and `dvd-calib-solve`. The target pattern encodes its own position, so a DVD's actual inner and outer radii can be solved directly from photos, with no point tracing. It is DVD-only and CLI-only, with no GUI integration.

Since the PR was opened, 1.4.0 added the staged coarse, boundary, and fine calibration flow, so how the two relate needs to be settled.

## Results so far

This is a small sample: two burned discs and 12 phone photos, 5 of them readable.

- Disc 3, generated from disc 2's solve, came back within about 0.05 turns, down from 123 turns uncalibrated.
- 10° to 20° of twist remains, with a maximum tangential offset of about 8 to 13 mm. There is no independent measurement of the true radii, so I can't tell whether this is measurement error or a real difference between discs or burns.
- Cubic pitch was not fitted.

Full data is in [this PR comment](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/pull/62#issuecomment-6627034720). I'm also collecting photos from more drives and discs in #122.

## Questions

1. **Role:** Is this better as a replacement for coarse calibration, providing a starting point for the boundary or fine stage, or as a separate flow? The maintainer said in #72 that improving photo calibration is the current priority. Does this PR fit that direction?
2. **Location:** Is it acceptable to keep the Python tool in this repo with the CLI forwarding to it? It isn't bundled into the single-file CLI and has to be installed separately. Or would you prefer an external tool with only docs here?
3. **Output:** The tool currently writes `code.fit.json`. Should it produce a calibration record the GUI can import?
4. **Accuracy bar:** How low does the remaining twist need to be for this to be worth merging? Is cubic pitch required before merging?
5. **Size:** The PR is 22 files and about 3600 lines. Should I split it into separate tool and CLI PRs?

The PR has been rebased onto 1.4.0 and has no conflicts. The `build` workflow is waiting for approval to run. Design feedback is welcome in the meantime.

省流：自动识别部分比较需要，最好能共用标定图案

以下是AI生成内容

**中文**

感谢提供自动标定工具，以及补充实盘测试和拍摄条件。建议先将这条路线作为**可选的实验性功能**，明确当前支持范围为使用专用图案的标准 12 cm DVD。现有独立 Python 工具与 CLI 入口对主系统影响较小，可以先沿用。

目前标定盘还不能直接统一：本 PR 的识别依赖六圈条码和多层角度编码，与现有三阶段使用的宽带、边界和十字线图案不兼容，频率回退也依赖专用图案。后续可以优先探索自动识别现有图案的测量点，再复用现有拟合流程；如果能够共用标定盘，仅集成自动识别部分，对系统的影响会更小。

作为实验性功能接入前，建议补齐以下问题：

1. **支持范围与生成参数。** 明确 DVD、12 cm 盘及绘图区的适用限制，保存和读取图案版本与完整生成参数，尤其是生成盘已有的三次轨距系数。目前的 `--cubic` 是尝试拟合实际轨距，不能代替原始生成参数。
2. **质量判定与回退。** 增加各照片独立解算的一致性检查，避免联合结果主要由一张照片决定却仍标为 `good`。明确区分频率粗估与精标结果，报告实际使用的模型和降级原因；粗估结果不应作为精标成功直接应用。
3. **拍照要求与通用性。** 当前两张实盘、同一手机的 12 张照片中有 5 张可读，低倾角也有失败，还需要不同手机、光照和盘片的验证。可读样本盘面直径约为 3200–5300 px，这只是样本观察，不应直接当作最低规格。现有 GUI 会缩小照片，将来集成时需要保留原图分析路径，并提供清晰的拍摄和重拍指引。
4. **确认流程与验证。** 保留结果预览和人工确认，识别失败时不影响现有流程。补充识别算法、异常照片、多照片冲突、回退及三次模型的回归测试，并通过应用参数后重新刻录来验证效果，不能只依赖拟合残差或参数小数位数判断精度。

**现有三阶段标定也刚上线，同样需要大家的使用反馈，不能视为已经充分验证的基准。** 希望两条路线都收集成功与失败样本，包括原始照片、手机、盘片、刻录机、刻速、生成参数、操作次数和复刻效果。先在不影响现有功能通用性的前提下开放实验，再根据反馈决定是否统一图案和进一步整合。

以上判断基于当前代码与本 PR 提供的实拍报告，尚未独立复测实盘。

---

**English**

Thank you for contributing the auto-calibration tool and documenting the shooting conditions and real-disc results. I suggest introducing this as an **optional experimental feature**, initially scoped to standard 12 cm DVDs using its dedicated target. The separate Python tool and CLI entry points have a relatively small impact on the main application and seem appropriate for this stage.

The calibration targets cannot currently be shared directly. This PR relies on a six-ring barcode and multi-layer angle codes, which differ from the bands, boundary patterns, and cross used by the existing three-stage workflow. The frequency fallback also depends on the dedicated target. A useful direction would be to detect measurement points on the existing targets automatically and reuse the current fitting pipeline. If we can share the targets, integrating only the automatic detection would have a smaller impact on the system.

Before integrating it as an experimental feature, I suggest addressing these points:

1. **Supported scope and generation parameters.** Document the DVD, disc-size, and drawing-area limitations. Preserve and read the target version and complete generation parameters, especially any cubic pitch coefficients already used to generate the disc. `--cubic` attempts to fit the actual pitch; it does not supply the original generation parameters.
2. **Quality assessment and fallback.** Check agreement between independently solved photos, so a joint result dominated by one photo is not rated `good` solely on aggregate metrics. Clearly distinguish frequency-based coarse estimates from fine calibration, and report the model actually used and any fallback reason. A coarse estimate should not be treated as a successful fine-calibration result ready to apply.
3. **Shooting requirements and general applicability.** Five of the twelve photos of two discs were readable, all taken with the same phone, and some low-tilt photos still failed. More testing across phones, lighting conditions, and media is needed. The readable samples had disc diameters of approximately 3200–5300 px; this is an observation, not an established minimum specification. Since the current GUI downsizes photos, future integration would need an original-resolution analysis path and clear shooting and retake guidance.
4. **Confirmation and validation.** Preserve result previews and manual confirmation, and keep the existing workflow available when detection fails. Add regression coverage for recognition, invalid photos, conflicting photos, fallback, and cubic fitting. Validate results by burning another disc with the fitted parameters, rather than relying solely on fit residuals or the number of decimal places reported.

**The existing three-stage calibration workflow has also only recently been released and needs community feedback. It should not be treated as a fully validated reference.** For both approaches, successful and failed cases would be valuable: original photos, phone and media details, burner model, write speed, generation parameters, number of attempts, and the results after reburning. We can first offer the experimental route without reducing the existing functionality’s general applicability, then use that feedback to decide whether to unify the targets and integrate further.

These observations are based on the current code and the real-disc report in this PR; they have not yet been independently verified with physical discs.

谢谢，这些意见我会逐项补齐。关于共用图案，我想说明专用图案的取舍。

环码可以自定位，多层角度码可以从照片直接确定相位圈数，这是它适合机器识别的原因。现有十字线和边界图案主要为人工描点设计，自动识别的精度不高，这是尝试过的。

专用图案的流程是：刻一张标定盘，拍多张照片，用整体照定位，用局部特写提高分辨率，再融合计算；之后可以再加一张验证盘。目前代码只能联合解算整体照片，局部融合还没有实现。

接下来我会先补生成参数、逐照片一致性检查、粗估与精标的区分和回归测试，也会用仓库里的示例记录试试自动识别现有粗标定图案的宽带边缘，再用数据讨论是否统一图案。今天晚些时候我会再做一次实盘测试。

---

Thanks, I'll work through these points. On sharing the target, I'd like to explain the trade-off of the dedicated pattern.

The ring barcode locates itself, and the multi-layer angle code resolves the phase turn count directly from a photo, which is what makes it suited to machine reading. The existing cross and boundary patterns are mainly designed for manual tracing, and automatic detection on them isn't very accurate. I've tried it.

The workflow with the dedicated pattern is: burn one calibration disc, take several photos, use whole-disc photos for locating and close-ups for extra resolution, and fuse them in the solve. One verification disc can be added afterwards. The code can currently only solve whole-disc photos jointly; fusing close-ups isn't implemented yet.

Next I'll add the generation parameters, per-photo agreement checks, the coarse/fine distinction, and regression tests. I'll also use the example records in the repo to try detecting the wide-band edges on the existing coarse target automatically, then we can discuss unifying the targets with data. I'll run another real-disc test later today.

我个人认为，目前没有太大必要单独开发这套基于照片的自动标定功能。

相比之下，我更希望将现有的 [disc-probe](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe) 项目整合进来，复用它已有的标定能力。

根据我目前的实际使用经验，通过 disc-probe 对一张 DVD 进行测量和分析，就有机会完成理想盘片参数的标定，不需要额外拍摄多张光盘，也不需要引入一套独立的照片标定流程。

因此，我更倾向于将开发精力放在两个项目的功能整合上，而不是重复实现已有能力。这样既能减少维护成本，也能让整个标定流程更加统一。

当然，如果照片标定方案能够覆盖现有工具无法解决的场景，其独立价值仍然值得讨论。


Personally, I don't think there is a strong need to develop a separate photo-based auto-calibration feature.

Instead, I'd prefer to integrate the existing [disc-probe](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe) project and reuse its existing calibration capabilities.

Based on my practical experience, measuring and analyzing a single DVD with disc-probe can provide enough information to calibrate the ideal disc parameters. This eliminates the need to photograph multiple discs or introduce a separate photo-based calibration workflow.

I'd rather focus development efforts on integrating the two projects instead of duplicating existing functionality. This would reduce maintenance overhead and provide a more consistent calibration workflow.

Of course, if photo-based calibration can handle use cases that the existing tools cannot, its independent value would still be worth discussing.

> 因此，我更倾向于将开发精力放在两个项目的功能整合上，而不是重复实现已有能力。这样既能减少维护成本，也能让整个标定流程更加统一。

title: GIGASTORAGE CD-R Works Perfecly.
body: GIGASTORAGE CD-R SETTINGS Measured 2026-11-05. Confirmed by the grid disc, not yet by a finished picture. Disc Unbranded silver-top CD-R, 80 min Maker (ATIP) Gigastorage Corporation Disc ID 97m28s12f / 79m59s74f Hub stamp not recorded yet Capacity 359,847 sectors Rated speed 10-24x Inner radius r0 24.98117 mm Outer radius r1 58.23549 mm at 359,847 sectors Track pitch 1.509977 um Bit length 277.662 nm (1200 mm/s) Along-track constant 7 frames (+/- 3) Curve correction degree 3: -3.50286, -0.34738, 2.07039, 0.10109 x = (r - 40) / 15, 2.4 deg peak to peak Patterns dark 0D, light AA Burn cdrdao, Mode 1 data, DAO, 10x Drive TSSTcorp SN-208FB, firmware D100, Linux ### Gigastorage CD-R: spiral measured by read timing, grid confirmed **Disc:** unbranded silver-top CD-R 80 min, ATIP Gigastorage Corporation, 97m28s12f/79m59s74f, 359,847 sectors, rated 10-24x **Drive:** TSSTcorp SN-208FB (D100), Linux, cdrdao DAO, Mode 1, 10x **Geometry (bit 277.662 nm):** - r0 = 24.98117 mm, r1 = 58.23549 mm at 359,847 sectors - pitch = 1.509977 um - along-track constant = 7 frames (+/- 3) - phi(r) degree 3 correction, x = (r - 40) / 15: -3.50286, -0.34738, 2.07039, 0.10109 (2.4 deg peak to peak) **Method:** disc-probe (Linux fork), `--media cd --cd-sector mode1`. - `rings` disc burned first. Patterns were clearly visible by eye under a lamp. - `timing --speed 1411`: CAV 2121.6 rpm, FUA honoured, jitter 1.0-1.4 deg. - `geo --host-delay-ms 35 --ranges 2000-305000`: 36 rungs, read through the texture rings as well as the random ones, rms 0.81 deg constant pitch, 0.56 deg with the degree 3 fit. Measured span 25.3-54.5 mm. - Grid disc on a second blank, burned at 206 frames. The grid appeared but twisted. Twist against radius from a lamp photo fits c + a/r with rms 0.36 deg, |a| = 199 frames, no linear term. So the constant on this drive is about 7, not 206, and disc 1's geometry carried over to disc 2. **Notes:** - The 7 frames comes from that photo fit. It has not yet been checked by burning a second grid. - The radii are for a Mode 1 data burn through disc-probe. I have not tested them with the audio track path. - A flatbed scanner (Epson XP-4200) barely saw the patterns: about 3/255 in the two dark sectors. Lamp photos worked far better. - Before this, my audio ladder discs never got closer than about 0.07 mm. Photos attached: ring disc and twisted grid.

nodes.body:
@arkwise Thanks, this is a very useful report. Fitting the twist to `c + a/r` from a lamp photo is a neat way to get the along-track constant without a second disc, and 7 against our 206 frames shows the value can't be carried between drives and burn paths. I'm sorry the 206 cost you a disc: it was in the manual's example command, and the manual now says not to copy it, with your result as the reason.

One thing may help anyone using these numbers. `disexport` now handles CD fits ([32bd7d0](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/commit/32bd7d0)), so your constant and degree 3 curve can go into a single DiscImageStudio preset, with the curve as its pitch coefficients:

```
python -m discprobe disexport --geo summary.json --correction correction.json --sectors 359847 --along-track-frames 7 --output dis_preset.json
```

Your fork needs to include that commit. The r0 and r1 above, used alone with zero coefficients, would leave out the 2.4 degree curve. CD export hasn't been checked on a burned disc yet, and as you say, 7 frames applies to your cdrdao Mode 1 path, so DiscImageStudio's own burn path could differ.

If you're happy with it, I'd like to add this drive to the README's table, credited to you.

![received_1825705761910102.jpeg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7fc276bc-9c42-40ad-882e-6d4d41918372)

Yeah I'll sort out a commit. Soon.

nodes.body: Slightly misalignments are often acceptable. .You can add more reference points or proceed directly to the next stage.

title: Feature request: add in the designer the "data circle" already visible in the preview
body:
Right now in the preview you can see how much space data occupy as a circle but that is not visible in the designer.
Being able to see the circle directly in the designer would help a lot in positioning images so that they don't overlap with data.
An idea could be add it as a not deletable layer (but that can be hidden).

目前，在预览中可以看到数据所占空间的圆形范围，但在设计器中看不到。
如果能在设计器中直接显示这个圆形范围，就能更方便地调整图片的位置，避免图片与数据重叠。
可以考虑将它添加为一个不可删除但可以隐藏的图层。

title: Bug: rotating an image sometimes hide it in the designer depending on the angle
body:
rotating an image sometimes hide it in the designer depending on the angle.
If you rotate na image almost upside down it disappear and is not visible until you change angle (but it always stay visible in the preview)

旋转图片时，图片有时会根据角度在设计器中消失。
如果把图片旋转到几乎倒置的角度，它就会消失；只有调整角度后才会重新显示（但它在预览中始终可见）

title: Can't Seem to get a disc to burn properly using Philips DVD+R preset.
body: I'm using Philips DVD+R discs and selecting the Philips preset when starting a new project. I can't get it to produce anything even close to an image. I used the live burn in the program and also exported and used ImgBurn and got the same result. Can someone help me understand what is happening? Do you have to calibrate to the disc even with the preset? I thought that was the point of a preset. Any help is greatly appreciated, thanks. I have included images of the discs although that may not be helpful.

nodes.body:
Many people have already reported that they obtained different parameters using the same product, which means that even for the same product, different batches may require different parameters.
We expect to switch soon to identifying discs uniquely by “product model + the code on the disc’s plastic inner ring.” Stay tuned.
For your disc, we have just updated the calibration process; ideally, it can produce calibration results while consuming only three discs. You are welcome to try it.
One more reminder: discs are easiest to observe under a desk lamp or flashlight, which is useful during calibration.

I went through the calibration process and got to the fine calibration, and when I got the disc out of the drive it has no line on it like shown in the calibration walkthrough. Did I mess up somewhere?

@sanitysama Thanks, it'd be great to compare numbers on that pack, and trying your other drives sounds like the quickest way there. Since it works on CD for you, the drive isn't simply unusable, it just isn't giving steady timing on DVD/BD yet.

Those messages mean reads aren't finishing at a steady rotation speed, so `geo` keeps settling and retrying. Before you swap anything, this might still be worth a try on the WH14NS40. On Sliicy's SP80NB80 a slower speed was what made `geo` finish on this same kind of disc:

```
python -m discprobe timing --drive E: --speed 3324
python -m discprobe geo --drive E: --speed 3324 --sectors 16
```

I haven't seen this drive before, so I can't say it'll help. `--sectors 16` reads whole ECC blocks, which has helped on some noisy drives. If it still struggles, the `timing` output would be useful to paste here, since it shows the rotation mode and jitter for this drive. All of these only read from the disc.

For your other drives, `timing` takes a few minutes and tells you whether one's worth a full `geo` run.

Your logs show something I got wrong. Your first `timing` run, with no `--speed`, was constant rotation at about 9280 rpm with 0.28–0.35° jitter, and the tool called the drive usable. Every run after you started passing `--speed` came back CLV, including the later run with no `--speed` at all. So the `--speed 3324` I suggested probably didn't help on this drive. My guess is the drive keeps the speed it was given until the disc is reloaded, but that's only a guess from the order of your runs.

Your first `geo` run also looks better than the messages suggest. It kept printing "spindle unsteady" and retrying, but the steps it finished agreed well (chi2/dof 0.03, 0.37 and 0.72) before you stopped it with Ctrl+C. So it may have been slow and not actually failing.

@sanitysama I need to correct what I told you about the WH14NS40. Someone pointed out a detail in your log that I missed.

Your `timing` ran at about 9278 rpm, but your `geo` started at about 3178 rpm. `geo` sets 5540 kB/s by default, and your own `timing --speed 5540` shows that puts this drive in CLV. At the radius `geo` started from, that CLV works out to about 3177 rpm, so it fits. `geo` never ran at 9280 rpm. I was wrong to say it kept getting interrupted at that speed, and wrong to suggest not spending more time on this drive. The problem was our tool, not your drive.

The 6 points still can't be used, since phase isn't an angle under CLV. They just say nothing about full speed, which hasn't been tried.

- `geo` now compares the rotation at the inner and outer parts of the disc first. If it's CLV, it stops within seconds and says what to do, instead of running for 18 minutes.
- `geo --speed keep` sends no speed command, so the drive stays as `timing` saw it.

@sanitysama Thank you, this is really good news (๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ All 22 points on the WH14NS40, so `--speed keep` did the job and the drive was never the problem.

I went through your files, and there's one thing I'd check before you burn: the preset you posted doesn't seem to match these measurements. Scored against your 22 points, it misses by 0.30° rms, and by 1.05° at 25.7 mm. That's about the same as no correction at all (0.29° rms). A correction made from this same run gets down to 0.14° rms. These commands are the ones `geo` suggests, and they did that here on your files:

```
python tools/geo_polyfit.py results\geo-E-20261107-133324 --write-correction correction.json --order quadratic
python -m discprobe disexport --geo results\geo-E-20261107-133324 --correction correction.json --sectors 2295104 --r-min 25.672 --r-max 54.216 --output dis_preset.json
```

You should get an inner radius of about 23.99148 mm, an outer radius of about 57.93579 mm, and a max angle difference of about 0.001°. Yours says 0.337°, and none of the other correction settings I tried gave your numbers. My guess is that `correction.json` was left over from an earlier run, but that's only a guess. If you still have that file and the command you used, I'd like to see them, in case it's a problem on our side. All of this only compares numbers with your read timing, so a test burn is still the real check.

Also, the preset's description says "grid-scan angle correction". That's our wording and it's wrong here, since you didn't scan anything. Please ignore it.

You were right to look twice at the rung where the speed changed, so here's what I found:

- The drive dropped from 9278 to 5913 rpm at point 4 and stayed there. None of the 1354 reads in the file failed. I don't know why it slowed down.
- The three points before the drop agree with the two right after it, within their noise (-0.07, -0.40 and -0.31° against -0.34 and -0.33°). So I don't see any sign that it hurt the result. Leaving those three out moves the fit by at most 0.2°, about the same as the fit's own uncertainty.
- The other thing lowering the score is that the track pitch on this disc isn't quite constant. The misses follow a smooth curve across the radius, which is what the correction fixes. The steepest part is between 39.2 and 42.4 mm, where there are no points, so I can't tell a steep slope from a sudden step there.

On your numbers differing from Sliicy's: we do expect some difference between batches, which is why we measure each one. Here the drive differs too, so I can't say how much of it comes from the batch.

Thanks for testing this again after the wrong steer from me (*´ω`)

@sanitysama Good thing you asked before burning (๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ `calib` doesn't use your measurements. It makes a fixed template from nominal values (r0 24.0 mm, pitch 0.74 µm) with 13 slightly different guesses side by side, for calibrating from a scan when there's no timing data at all. You already have a timing measurement, so it isn't the disc to burn here.

For a proof of your measurement, use `image`. Given no picture, it draws a grid test placed with your geometry and your correction:

```
python -m discprobe image --geo results\geo-E-20261107-133324 --correction correction.json --output iso\grid.iso
```

It prints the geometry it used and the run it came from, so you can check that it names `geo-E-20261107-133324`. Then burn `grid.iso` onto a blank from the same batch with any burner. Windows' own "Burn disc image" is fine.

What to look at: the grid's lines should stay straight all the way from the inside to the outer edge (the grid goes out to 56 mm). If the measurement is off, they bend or twist into a slight spiral, most likely past 54 mm or between 39 and 42 mm, where you have no points. A photo is enough for me to see that. If you'd also like a number, a flatbed scan of the data side lets `gridscan` measure how far the lines bend.

If you'd rather test the DIS preset itself, burning a picture with long straight lines in DIS with that preset works too. The two should come out the same, since the preset matches the measurement to 0.001°.
@Ashley-QwQ i have a flatbed scan at 1200 dpi showing the straight lines have a slight warble to them. so this calibration is quite close to usable.

@sanitysama Thank you for burning it and scanning it (๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ I ran your scan through `gridscan`, which lines the scan up with the design and measures, ring by ring, how far the lines are turned from where they should be.

Most of the curvy look is the design itself. The grid has circles as well as straight lines, and near the edge where the circles run almost parallel to the straight lines, the two cross back and forth and look like wavy diamonds.

What's left over is small:

- 0.06° rms and 0.33° peak to peak over 240 rings from 25 to 55 mm.
- No drift from the inside to the outside (0.02° over 25 to 55 mm), so the geometry itself is right.
- A gentle wave of about ±0.07°, roughly 10 mm long. That's the warble you see. At 55 mm, 0.07° moves a line by about 0.07 mm, a quarter of the line width.
- The largest part of the peak to peak is the innermost 2 mm (25 to 27 mm), which is off by about 0.15°. Without it, peak to peak is about 0.14°.

For comparison, our best grid on a GH70N came out at 0.11° peak to peak and 0.03° rms. So yours is close, and the remaining wave looks like the pitch of this batch varying a little more than the quadratic correction can follow. Some of it could also be the scan. Your scanner stretches one direction by about 0.3%, which `gridscan` measures and corrects.

If you want to take it further, `gridscan` writes a `phi.csv` and the `correction` command can turn it into a correction for the next burn from this batch. For pictures, I'd call this usable as it is.

@Ashley-QwQ i'd like to submit the most detailed results that i can, and i'd like to commit to making corrections as finely as possible for a preset for my pack of media. i ran `gridscan` with the following arguments and got phi.csv and summary.json as results.

```
PS C:\Users\Fractal\disc-probe> python -m discprobe gridscan --dpi 1200 --media dvd '.\Nov07&01.JPG'

  phi.csv and summary.json: C:\Users\Fractal\disc-probe\results\gridscan-Nov07&01-20261107-205133
```

[summary.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34535525/summary.json)

@sanitysama Thanks, your `phi.csv` matches what I got from the scan.

One thing matters before you make a correction from it. You burned the grid with `correction.json` from the timing run, so the scan only shows what that correction left. The next correction has to be the two added together, and until now `correction` couldn't do that: it would have thrown the timing correction away. I've added `--base` for this:

```
python -m discprobe correction results\gridscan-Nov07&01-20261107-205133\phi.csv --base correction.json --degree 10 --output refined.json
python -m discprobe image --geo results\geo-E-20261107-133324 --correction refined.json --output iso\grid2.iso
```

(Update your copy first. Put the `phi.csv` path in quotes if PowerShell complains about the `&`.)

On the degree: I tried your `phi.csv` by leaving out 2 mm at a time and checking how well the rest predicts it. The default degree 4 doesn't help. Degree 8 to 10 predicts the middle of the disc to about 0.04° rms, against 0.054° with no further correction. So the gain from this scan is real but small. In the innermost and outermost 2 mm a high degree is not reliable, so check those parts on the next burn.

Two things would make it better:

- More scans. Rotate the disc about 90° between scans and give `correction` all the `phi.csv` files together. Anything that comes from the disc turns with it, while scanner errors (a flatbed head that moves a little unevenly can draw a wave like this one) don't, so they average out.
- Burning from `image` rather than a DiscImageStudio preset. A preset has only three pitch terms, and those can't follow a wave about 10 mm long, so `disexport` would smooth it away. You can still export one with `--correction refined.json`, and it prints how far the preset is from the map.

To be honest about the scale: you're at 0.06° rms now, and this would take it toward 0.04°. At 55 mm that's a difference of about 0.02 mm, which you probably won't see on a picture. It's worth doing if you want the most exact preset for the pack, but the disc you have is already good (◍•ᴗ•◍)

title: 建议改进删除功能
body: 删除工程不会导致下载下来的iso等文件一并被删除，且iso等文件下载到路径没有明确的索引，非常杂乱，建议可以生成对应文件夹来储存

nodes.body:
感谢反馈。

从软件的操作逻辑的角度，个人认为将产出的镜像文件与项目保持联系是不合适的。一如修图软件与成图，剪辑软件与导出视频的关系。
镜像文件本身属于一个有独立价值的产物，存储的是“结果”——您可以将它单独送入其他设备，甚至于用于可能的工业生产；
而软件本身的“项目”“项目文件”，即 .discproj 后缀的文件等设计，也是在这一考虑下诞生的，它们存储的是“流程”，与 .PSD 文件等概念类似。
“结果”与“过程”的分离是个人认为更为合适的做法，也更好地适应了不同用户群体的资料储存习惯。

当然，现有的实现依然是半成品，“工程”等概念的引入来源于两周前的 PR #4 ，还欠缺打磨。接下来会有相关保存配置项与保存流程的优化，欢迎关注。“项目文件夹”的概念与“工程”概念存在定位上的重复，大概率不会引入。但若有更好的建议，欢迎讨论！

不过一次工程产出各种文件（png，wav，cue，iso）这些，格式杂乱，这和修图软件等逻辑有些不同，这些文件生成的大多是同类型的文件，但本项目的产出是功能不重叠，或者说不可分离的，考虑到这些的话文件管理上相当不适。iso这些文件很大，如果没有充分的指引，对于小白来说可以是一场灾难。
如果这个概念不决定修改的话，那我还是建议导出的逻辑优化一下，让用户个人每次都可以选择存储文件的位置，个人觉得比较普适，希望能考虑一下。

title: DVD 空盘“从光盘读取”的扇区数比实际可写的多约 608，可能导致封盘失败
body:
你好！我们在 #107 里碰到几次“图像刻完了，但 DIS 报封盘失败”，查下来可能和 DVD 的总扇区数有关，想和你确认一下。原因我们还不确定，下面是目前看到的数字。

| 盘 | 空白盘 READ TRACK INFORMATION 的可写扇区 | 偏大的数 | 多出 |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| RITEKF1，120 mm（GH70N 上读） | 2,297,888 | 2,298,496（内置预设 `ritek-dvd-r-e-series`） | 608 |
| RITEKG04，80 mm（UJ272 上读） | 713,936 | 714,546（“从光盘读取”） | 610 |
| 同上 | 713,936 | 714,544（内置预设 `dvd-5-80mm`） | 608 |

两种盘多出的数几乎一样，容量却差了三倍多，所以不太像误差。

刻录结果（都是用户在 #107 的反馈，不是我们自己刻的）：

- 总扇区 2,298,496，UJ272 和 DVR-S21，DIS 1.4.1、1.4.2：图像完整，封盘报失败（[Lakida0](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107#discussioncomment-19436444)）。
- 总扇区 2,295,104，同一批盘，UJ272：封盘正常（[domerawind](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107#discussioncomment-19440415)）。这次校准数据也一起换了，所以不算只改了扇区数。这个数也比容量小，没有试过正好 2,297,888。
- 总扇区 714,546 这个数，domerawind 说 [mini 盘上照它填也是同样的现象](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107#discussioncomment-19442161)，RITEKF1 上也见过，但没有给出那次读到的具体数。

代码里 `ReadMediaSectorCount` 在 DVD 上用的是 `TotalSectorsOnMedia`，注释说这样才包含已用扇区。我的猜测是，空白盘上这个值可能把一段不能写的区域也算进去了，但我没有在 Windows 上单独读过这个值，这点需要验证。

如果猜得对，几个可能有用的方向，你看着判断就好：

- 空白盘上改用 READ TRACK INFORMATION 的 free blocks，或者在两个数不一致时提示一下。
- 内置的 `ritek-dvd-r-e-series`、`dvd-5-80mm` 可能要核对扇区数。只改扇区数会改变几何，外半径和轨距系数要一起重算。威宝 AZO 那两个预设写的是 2,297,888，正好和可写扇区一致。

顺带说明：disc-probe 的 `disexport` 之前也默认 2,298,496，这个我们已经去掉了，现在要求手动填，并以空白盘上 `info` 的数为准。

如果需要更多数据，我们可以在别的光驱上再读一次。

nodes.body:
补充一条 domerawind 刚给的[数据](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107#discussioncomment-19443647)。Nero DiscSpeed 读到的字节数也和偏大的数一致，所以这不只是 DIS 的读法：

| 盘 | Nero 的字节数 | 换算扇区 | 对比 | 差 |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|
| RITEKF1 | 4,707,319,808 | 2,298,496 | 空盘可写 2,297,888（GH70N，`info`） | 608 |
| RITEKG04（mini） | 1,463,388,160 | 714,545 | Nero 的空白容量 1,462,142,976 字节 = 713,937 | 608 |

所以我上面说的 `TotalSectorsOnMedia`“把一段不能写的区域算进去”，可能是光驱或盘本身报告的总量就比可写的多 608，而不是某个软件算错了。这 608 个扇区是什么我还不知道。正文里 RITEKF1 那行写的来源是内置预设，现在也有了实际读数。
经典2298496 vs 2297888。开overburn就可解，没什么大不了的

@bczhc 谢谢，这下多出来的 608 就有解释了：它们不是不能写，而是默认不让写，要开 overburn 才能用。那我正文里说的“不能写的区域”可以改成这个意思。

那 DIS 这边的问题就变成：没开 overburn 时，总扇区却按 2,298,496 算，所以才会图像写完、封盘报错。要么空盘默认按 2,297,888，要么在超出时提示要开 overburn，看作者怎么取舍。DIS 的流式刻录能不能开 overburn，我还没查到。
@bczhc 没在dis里看见超刻选项，用的Deamon tools ultra也禁止iso超刻，现代刻录软件似乎为了安全都放弃支持超刻，要生成iso然后用古早软件刻录吗

> [@bczhc](https://github.com/bczhc) 谢谢，这下多出来的 608 就有解释了：它们不是不能写，而是默认不让写，要开 overburn 才能用。那我正文里说的“不能写的区域”可以改成这个意思。
> 
> 那 DIS 这边的问题就变成：没开 overburn 时，总扇区却按 2,298,496 算，所以才会图像写完、封盘报错。要么空盘默认按 2,297,888，要么在超出时提示要开 overburn，看作者怎么取舍。DIS 的流式刻录能不能开 overburn，我还没查到。


反正我在linux上，有意思的就是cdrskin跟cdrecord的minfo都报2298496 blank sector大小，但cdrecord真要写这么大的文件时，会说多了608扇区，最大只能2297888。而cdrskin就能接收2298496 sector的文件。但cdrecord，如果加`-overburn`，也接收2298496扇区大小文件。这点608差异应该没什么所谓，就差了一点点，我觉得甚至有的软件会报这个有的会报另一个。我就在 https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/87#issuecomment-6630231132 如此说

那就是流式写入没这功能了罢，自己生成iso然后截了吧。cli的话倒是有[`--fill-sectors`](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/blob/0f64779fae61f1a9aa6f5360ee6e941088a13eae/docs/DVD_ENGINE.md?plain=1#L357-L363) 直接控制输出的最大值。
@Ashley-QwQ 刻录已完成，封盘正常，使用disexport --geo latest --sectors 2297888生成的json，Ridata盘（ritekf1）测试。 [00:39:28] 流式刻录完成：4706074624 字节，耗时 993.0 秒，实际速度=4× · 5.5 MB/s。 图像正常，图像边缘可以达到盘片边缘（目测）

感谢提醒，检查下来问题主要出在DVD上，API查询到的总扇区数是包含管理信息的，应当使用`FreeSectorsOnMedia`。CD可能存在TAO导致的2扇区开销问题，BD标准规定数据区满驱动器应当处理封盘。

微软文档中提到DVD±RW、DVD-RAM、BD-RE在引入文件系统前`FreeSectorsOnMedia`返回的是总扇区数，因此还需要特殊处理。

此外还发现存在扇区对齐问题，还要考虑已有预设的处理。

目前暂定处理方案如下：

1. 预设中添加可用扇区字段
2. 缺失可写扇区数的DVD预设减去608扇区
3. CD统一减去2可用扇区，同时兼容TAO/DAO
4. 流式刻录时读取可写扇区数作为约束

以下是GPT辅助查找内容

---

核对代码及相关规范后，需要区分三个概念：**盘片总容量、当前记录模式可写的容量，以及保留已有文件后剩余的容量**。这三者不一定相等。

| 盘片类型 | 当前读取方式 | 与可写容量、封盘的关系 |
|---|---|---|
| **CD** | ATIP 引出区起点换算出的节目区总扇区数 | TAO 和 DAO 的可写范围可能不同。项目历史记录中，同一盘 TAO 为 359,843，DAO 上限为 359,845，差值与 TAO 两个轨尾 run-out 块的开销吻合。当前使用 DAO，按设备返回的引出区起点上限检查，无需再扣整段引出区长度。 |
| **DVD** | IMAPI `TotalSectorsOnMedia` | 微软明确说明，该值即使在空白盘上也不保证等于可用扇区数。DVD-R 增量记录需要为边界结束结构保留空间，可以解释本 issue 的 608 扇区差额。 |
| **BD** | `READ FORMAT CAPACITIES` | 当前仅支持全新、未格式化、单层无备用区 BD-R。写前还会交叉检查轨道容量、可写容量和下一可写地址，并非直接相信总数。该布局可以写满用户数据区后封盘。 |

其中，DVD-R 的 **608 扇区有明确的格式依据**：

```text
缩短边界结束区 TBO：37 ECC 块 × 16 = 592 扇区
边界同步保护块 BSGA：1 ECC 块 × 16 =  16 扇区
合计                                  608 扇区
```

ECMA-359 附录 M.1 规定最终边界结束区可以缩短为 37 个 ECC 块；MMC-6 规定空白／未完成记录区的轨道容量应排除 Border-out／TBO 和额外的 16 扇区 BSGA。因此：

```text
2,298,496 − 608 = 2,297,888
  714,544 − 608 =   713,936
```

这部分属于**引出区之前的边界开销**，不是整个引出区，也不能推广成所有 DVD 都固定少 608。[ECMA-359 附录 M](https://www.ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-359_1st_edition_december_2004.pdf)、[MMC-6 §6.26.3.18.5](https://13thmonkey.org/documentation/SCSI/mmc6r02g.pdf#page=536)

如果将这些预留位置也计入用户数据输出，设备可能在写入、缓存刷新或关闭会话时拒绝，因而可能表现为“图像已出现，最后收尾失败”。但当前程序已经检查 IMAPI Free 容量，所以**具体失败命令及为何容量检查放行，仍需同一次刻录的容量读数和错误日志确认**。现有实刻反馈确认了 2,297,888 扇区重新拟合后的预设可以正常封盘，但尚不能替代这部分诊断。[实刻反馈](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/183#issuecomment-6690200194)

BD-R 的情况不同：当前支持的布局要求  
`FreeBlocks = TrackSize = MaximumBlocks = 12,219,392`。封盘写入专用 DMA 管理区；规范明确允许用户数据空间耗尽后封盘，因此无需额外扣除 608 或 32 扇区。这个结论限定于当前支持的 BD-R 模式，不适用于任意已格式化、已写入或带备用区的蓝光盘。[BD 命令集 §6.2.2.1](https://www.t10.org/ftp/t10/document.08/08-340r0.pdf#page=87)

@JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat 谢谢！608 = 37 个 ECC 块的 TBO + 16 扇区 BSGA，这下 608 从哪里来就清楚了，也和两种盘的数都对得上。“预设里单独加可用扇区字段”这个做法很好，这样已有预设的几何不用动。

补一个小数据，和你说的 CD 差 2 扇区对得上：我们一批 CD-R 上，ATIP 算出的是 359,849，空盘的可写扇区是 359,847，正好差 2。

title: Perfect Calibration but still can't produce image
body: Hello, I am trying to produce a simple drawing image on a disk but failing. Successfully calibrated the disk. Line is straight as it should. Optical Drive: PLDS DVD+-RW. DU-8A5LH Tried disk types: Philips CD-RW 700MB 80min 4-12x speed, Philips CD-R 700MB 80min 52x speed Calibration on the disk: Result with print: I tried tweaking the brightness and dithering, gray levels, also gamma but without any result they were the same.

nodes.body: try something with thick lines, the thicker the lines between colors are, the better visibility. But I'm not sure with this  situation, just  a  suggestion.
I have tried photos, almost same anime drawing as on the README, thick lines but without any luck.
Did you save the calibration result as a preset and use it?

Yes, I have save it and used it as well.
Also I have tried the preset in an other project, did the precision calibration and it came out well. But the custom design not.

@TMarccci I noticed a strange bug when I calibrated my disc that when applying the calibration and then saving it as a preset, it did not actually save the linear, cubic and quadratic values but kept the old ones. You might want to look into that, because if they changed, then the image won't appear at all or will look very warped. For example, my correct values are: inner: 23.991460702437305 outer: 57.93579168028281 sectors: 2295104 linear: -2.6724564452606465E-05 quadratic: 4.0503386747536064E-05 cubic: -2.771840423519746E-05 But the preset keeps remembering the wrong ones so I need to change it each time: WRONG VALUES: Linear: -2.1293990601237857E-06 Quadratic: -1.0728145734002103E-06 Cubic: -5.796740088071808E-08 So I would say pay close attention to all 6 values after calibrating it and ensure they are set correctly under Preview > Geometry > Project Settings. As well as Preview > Advanced Preview Settings values. See photos.

The parameter synchronization and calibration persistence fixes have now been committed to **`main`**: [15cf4a7](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/commit/15cf4a7).

The changes cover three behaviors:

- **Switching project presets now updates Advanced Preview Settings**, including the inner/outer radii and all three pitch coefficients.
- **Saving a preset from Project Settings immediately applies it to the current project.** Closing or cancelling the settings dialog afterward preserves that applied parameter set.
- **Confirmed calibration fits are now saved in calibration records.** Reopening a record restores the selected result, confirmation, and fitted parameters. The original parameters used to burn the photographed disc remain preserved separately.

These changes were tested for CD, DVD, and BD, and the full CI build passed.

If you still encounter old coefficients with a build containing this commit, please share the application version, the affected preset entry from `disc-presets.json`, and the steps that reproduce it.

First of all thank you for all of your helps.

I have updated to the new version and I changed the project's geometery and it did the job! The print came out crystal clear and crisp.

I hope this threads helps the one who needs it.

Keep up the good work! 😎

Hey @TMarccci. I'm having this issue on version 1.5.0, the latest .exe release. I completed the first calibration process successfully and did not do the rest, and the disk came out showing absolutely nothing. 
Is completing all 3 calibration stages for image printing mandatory? 

I would appreciate if you could dumb it down for me so I understand what I'm doing wrong. Thanks in advance!

Hello @mmnjrzdgn !

I suggest you to do all of the calibration steps. Because even the last fine detailing had some misalignment for me after 2 steps.
Let me break it down what I did.

First of all I have used a CD-RW to make it cheaper to fail a print or calibration procedure.
When I did the some burning to the disk I always took 10-20 photos of the back of the disk to make sure I have the best quality for the calibration. 
I used a tool called Nero Disk Burner to format the rewritable disk because windows failed on the formatting.
Also look up other issues messages, they are helpful with the calibration.

I followed this calibration steps: docs/CALIBRATION_TUTORIAL.md
Than the issue was that was related to my problem got fixed. But also make sure to check your calibration values.
For last check that your project contains the calibration values that you've got as a result on Preview -> Geometry -> Edit -> Preset details.

Best,
Marcell

title: 中環 CMC MAG. AM3 DVD-R 從「完全看不到」到成功出圖的標定過程
body: ### 環境 - Disc Image Studio 版本：1.3.6 - Windows 11 專業版 25H2 - 燒錄機：Transcend TS8XDVDS-K（USB 外接薄型） - 燒錄：匯出 ISO，用 ImgBurn 2.5.8.0 以 4x 燒錄 - 光碟：RONEVER DVD-R 16X，MID：`CMC MAG. AM3`，內圈刻碼 `CMDR47G-CFMWM03-6865 65GR1817` ### 最終參數（程式校準後） - 內半徑 r0：23.9667913 mm - 外半徑 r1：57.9550043 mm - 磁區數：2297888 - 相對一次項：0.0011325572 - 相對二次項：-0.0024193841 - 相對三次項：0.0015954637 （相對次項是從預覽頁顯示的軌距公式反算，10 位有效數字） ### 過程 **1. 標準預設完全不行** 用「標準 12cm 單層 DVD」燒校準盤，同心圓肉眼就看得到，但十字線完全看不到，圖片盤也什麼都沒有。改用「Verbatim DVD-R AZO」預設燒校準盤，十字線一樣看不到。 **2. 改燒「半黑半白」測試圖** 十字線太細，參數一錯就捲到看不見。改燒左半黑、右半白的圖，分界線被扭成螺旋，比較看得出來。用 Verbatim 預設燒出約 20 條螺旋紋。 **3. 用預覽的「實測參數」反推** 在預覽頁「實測參數與預覽精度」調內外半徑，讓預覽出現跟實體光碟一樣的螺旋，那組數字就接近光碟真實尺寸，再填回專案參數燒下一片。觀察到： - 內半徑錯：紋路內圈密、往外變粗 - 外半徑錯：紋路內圈疏、往外變密 - 兩者都錯且方向相反：紋路中段會折回，出現一個「舌頭」，舌頭內外各半數紋路 - 比較兩片舌頭的方向，可判斷修過頭還是還沒修夠 | 片 | r0 | r1 | 結果 | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | 23.991461 | 57.964894 | 約 20 條，往外變粗 | | A | 23.991461 | 57.928894 | 舌頭，內外各 7 條 | | A-2 | 23.955461 | 57.964894 | 舌頭，內外各 3 條 | | A-3 | 23.967461 | 57.953894 | 一個順時針舌頭 | | 圖 1 | 23.964461 | 57.955894 | 逆時針舌頭，圖片看得出來 | | 圖 2 | 23.965761 | 57.954594 | 外圈臉已清楚，內圈小順時針舌頭 | （相對次項都維持 Verbatim 預設值） DVD 對參數非常敏感：外圈附近，半徑差 0.001 mm 大約就會多轉近一圈。 **4. 最後用程式校準收尾** 另一桶同型號的片子用上面的參數，還是有小舌頭。這時誤差已經小到十字線看得到，就燒程式的校準盤： - 用簽字筆在讀寫面沿十字線描出來，拍照比較清楚 - 相片校正：外緣、內緣偏差各 0.6 像素 - 沿一條十字線由內往外點 37 點，勾選「擬合 DVD 三次軌距分佈」 - 候選 1：平均偏差 0.243 mm，最大 0.506 mm，套用後燒圖成功 ### 心得 - 參數差太多時十字線看不到，程式的校準無法使用，可以先用半黑半白圖加預覽比對，手動把誤差縮小到十字線看得見，再交給程式校準 - 中環 AM3 校準出的相對軌距係數（約 10⁻³）比 Verbatim 預設（約 10⁻⁵）大很多，代表軌距分佈形狀不同；只調內外半徑會一直殘留一個「舌頭」，最後需要勾選「擬合 DVD 三次軌距分佈」才能修乾淨 - 預覽正常只代表專案參數和實測參數一致，不代表符合實體光碟 - USB 薄型燒錄機燒 DVD 用 8x 會 I/O 錯誤（應是供電不足），4x 才穩；燒錄中碰到燒錄機也會中斷 - 「讀取光碟」那步可以跳過，直接選預設 - 另外試過三菱 Golden PC disc CD-R（金片，ImgBurn 顯示製造商為 CMC Magnetics），用標準 80min CD 範本，校準盤和圖片盤都完全看不到，推測是染料對比太低 （附圖：第一片螺旋、A-2 舌頭、描線後的校準盤、最終成品）

nodes.body:
@ozn1911 Sorry about the wasted discs. I'm not a DIS developer, I work on a separate measuring tool called [disc-probe](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe), but I've seen this failure before and I think there's a way to stop losing discs while you find out what your drive can do.

The first errors in your log look harmless: the program reported that the disc wasn't a CD, and a few seconds later it read 2,297,888 sectors from it. The burn itself is what failed. The drive stopped at about LBA 126,000 with `0xC0AA0301`, around 5% of the way in. I don't think your calibration settings caused that, because the disc never got far enough for them to matter.

Two reports look similar:

- A TSSTcorp SN-208FB, a close relative of your SE-208DB going by the name, [burned normal data fine at up to 8x](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107#discussioncomment-19435910) but failed on picture patterns with this same error, somewhere between about 0.3 MB and 284 MiB. That person tried three kinds of disc.
- [PR #188](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/pull/188) reports the same error on another slim drive and adds an experimental setting that changes the picture data a little. It isn't merged yet. In their tests the failure at 8x went away with that setting, and 4x still failed, so a slower burn didn't help there.

So my guess is that this drive dislikes long runs of the same pattern, and that it isn't your discs or your settings. That's only an inference from those two reports, since nobody has tested an SE-208DB.

If you want to try before spending another disc, this reads the drive and disc and writes nothing:

```
python -m discprobe info
```

That shows the write speeds the drive lists for this disc and the disc's ID. It would help a lot if you could post the output here.

The next disc I'd spend on ordinary data, because it answers whether the drive and disc are fine with normal content. A burn of any normal files, or of `python -m discprobe random --output iso/random.iso`, is enough. If that also fails, the drive or the discs are the problem. If it works, the problem is the patterns, and that disc is still useful: disc-probe can measure the calibration from it by read timing, with no calibration pattern to burn. On the SN-208FB that measuring worked well. Your drive hasn't been tried, so I can't promise the same.

Getting calibrated won't fix the failure when you burn a picture, though. For that you'd need the #188 setting or a different drive, and on the SN-208FB we ended up suggesting a different drive.

thanks for help, yesterday i had noticed some other post shares their verbatim disk  calibration, which had same code()cmdr47g-cfmwmo3) as hp disk i had and thus i copied that one's calibration instead, it worked that way
then i burned the image using 1.3.6 version which previously worked for me

感谢补充 v1.5.0 的日志，这次能进一步缩小问题范围了：

- Raw P-W 修复已生效，盘片识别为空白 CD-R，容量没有超限。
- 程序的 64 MiB 缓冲已满，生成器没有异常；IMAPI 缓冲也接近满载，没有显示供数不足。
- 写入地址在导入区推进到 -10517 后停止，尚未进入绘图音轨内容，随后返回 0xC0AA0301。

因此，目前重点怀疑的是 Windows IMAPI 的 RAW DAO 写入方式与这台光驱／固件／盘片组合的兼容问题，还不能直接认定刻录机或光盘损坏。这个错误码比较笼统，日志中仍缺少底层 SCSI sense，暂时无法确定具体原因。

麻烦再帮忙确认：

1. 同一刻录机、同批全新 CD-R，用其他软件（比如ImgBurn）刻录普通音频 CD 能否成功？如果失败，请附该软件的完整错误日志。
2. CD-R 的品牌、型号，以及光驱是直连电脑 USB，还是通过扩展坞／集线器连接？
3. 如果普通音频 CD 能成功，再对比本程序导出的 WAV/CUE，会更有助于判断是否集中在 RAW DAO 路径。

title: Calibration parameters for Verbatim CD-RW 700MB 12X (Mitsubishi Chemical)
body: I would like to contribute my calibration parameters and test results for the following disc. - **Product:** Verbatim CD-RW 700MB 12X Rewritable Disc - **Source:** [[Amazon product page](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Verbatim+CD-RW+700MB+12X+10+Pack)](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Verbatim+CD-RW+700MB+12X+10+Pack) - **Manufacturer:** Mitsubishi Chemical Corporation - **Media ID (ATIP):** `97m34s23f` - **Capacity:** 700 MB / 80 min - **Rated speed:** 12X ## Calibration Parameters The following parameters were obtained through the three-step calibration process in DiscImageStudio. | Parameter | Value | |---|---| | Inner radius r0 (mm) | 24.848209 | | Outer radius r1 (mm) | 58.041015 | | Sector count | 359848 | | Relative first term | -5.229587171123637E-05 | | Relative second term | 7.120594884172674E-05 | | Relative third term | -3.583698278829937E-05 | ## Calibration Image The calibration process was completed using the above parameters. ## Writing Result I tested image writing on the disc using the calibrated parameters. ## Additional Notes The three-step calibration was completed successfully, and the calibration lines appeared straight and properly aligned. The image was also successfully written to the Verbatim CD-RW. However, due to the disc's low visual contrast, the written image is only clearly visible under direct flashlight illumination and at certain viewing angles. Under normal ambient lighting, the image is very difficult to distinguish. This suggests that DiscImageStudio can successfully write visible images to this CD-RW media, although the visibility is significantly dependent on lighting conditions and viewing angle.

title: [Feature Required] 支持刻录混合模式 CD 镜像（数据轨 + CD-DA 音轨）
body:
### 功能描述

希望 DiscImageStudio 能够支持导入和刻录混合模式 CD 镜像，即同一张光盘中同时包含数据轨和 CD-DA 音轨。

希望支持以下镜像格式：

- **MDF/MDS**：Alcohol 120% 创建的镜像格式。
- **NRG**：Nero 创建的镜像格式。

### 期望功能

1. 能够读取上述格式中的数据轨和 CD-DA 音轨。
2. 保留原始光盘的轨道顺序、轨道类型、Pregap（预间隙）及 Index 信息。
3. 支持使用 DAO（Disc-At-Once，整盘一次刻录）方式，将数据轨和音轨按照原始布局刻录到同一张 CD-R 中。
4. 尽可能保证刻录后的光盘与原始镜像具有一致的轨道布局和内容。

### 使用场景

许多老游戏和多媒体光盘采用混合模式 CD 结构，例如包含一条数据轨和多条 CD-DA 音轨。

目前希望能够直接使用 DiscImageStudio 刻录这类镜像，而不需要借助其他软件。

感谢开发者考虑加入这项功能！

title: v1.5.0 win-x64 crashes at startup with 0x80131506 on Windows 11 (CET shadow stack / QueueUserAPC2 check)
body:
**Environment**
- Disc Image Studio v1.5.0, `DiscImageStudio-v1.5.0-win-x64.exe` (SHA-256 matches the release)
- Windows 11, build 21H2 / 22000.613
- CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 5600G

**Problem**
The exe exits immediately, no window. Event Viewer shows:

- Application Error, ID 1000, exception code `0x80131506`, fault offset `0xbc038` (faulting module = the exe itself)
- .NET Runtime, ID 1023: `CoreCLR Version: 10.0.1426.52326`, `.NET Version: 10.0.14`, "The process was terminated due to an internal error in the .NET Runtime at IP 0x00007FF62894C038 (0x00007FF628890000) with exit code 0x80131506"

**Analysis**
RVA `0xBC038` is in a runtime startup function that checks whether user-mode shadow stacks are active (`rdsspq`), looks up `kernel32!QueueUserAPC2`, and if it is unavailable does a fail-fast with `0x80131506`. The message string in the binary is: "Your Windows doesn't fully support CET. Please install all available Windows updates."

The PE header of the exe has `CET_COMPAT` set (IMAGE_DEBUG_TYPE_EX_DLLCHARACTERISTICS = 0x1), so Windows enables shadow stacks for it by default.

I'm not sure why `QueueUserAPC2` is unavailable/failing on my system (I'm on Windows 11). I only know the crash happens on startup and goes away when shadow stacks are off.

**Workaround (confirmed working)**
Windows Security → App & browser control → Exploit protection → Program settings → add the exe → "Hardware-enforced Stack Protection" → Override → Off. After that the app starts normally.

**Suggestion**
Publish with `<CetCompat>false</CetCompat>` in the csproj (another .NET 9+/10 project fixed the same startup crash this way), or mention the CET requirement in the README. Release notes currently say Windows 10 2004+ / Windows 11 x64 are supported, so a system that fails this check hits the crash without any explanation.

Happy to provide more info (full event XML etc.) if needed.

nodes.body:
Thanks for the detailed investigation. I've set `<CetCompat>false</CetCompat>` for the Windows application in [7abf40c](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/commit/7abf40c0bd61db54e4f237f9f32dbb0b5853bb85).

Both x64 and native ARM64 packages now pass CI, including verification that the CET flag is cleared, self-tests, and GUI startup checks. This change applies to the application only and does not modify system-wide security settings.

The fix is on `main` and will be included in the next release. Test builds are available in the [CI artifacts](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/actions/runs/42446825106). Please try the new x64 build with your manual per-program override removed and confirm whether it starts on your original system.

Thanks for the quick fix!

I tested the `windows-ci-win-x64` artifact from run 42446825106 on the same PC where the original v1.5.0 crashed. I removed my per-program exploit-protection override beforehand, so no mitigation overrides apply to this exe. It starts normally, no more 0x80131506.

Even discs of the same model can yield different calibration data across different production batches; you’ll need to check the detailed matrix number etched onto the innermost hub ring to be certain.

Also, desktop optical drives seem somewhat inconsistent—I recommend using a slim drive instead (the type where you manually snap the disc onto the central spindle motor).
